description: This file is a centralized API client for a chat endpoint within a React project. It provides functions to determine the API base URL based on environment variables, perform fetch requests with timeout handling, and send chat messages to the backend API with detailed error handling. Key functions include getApiBaseUrl, fetchWithTimeout, and sendChatRequest.

methods.name: getApiBaseUrl()
methods.description: Determines the base URL for the API, prioritizing environment variable REACT_APP_API_BASE_URL or defaulting to same-origin.

methods.name: fetchWithTimeout(resource, options = {})
methods.description: Wraps the fetch API with a timeout, aborting the request if it exceeds the specified duration.

methods.name: sendChatRequest({ messages, prompt })
methods.description: Sends a chat message request to the backend API, handling responses and errors with detailed messaging.
